Gnosis.$comment: WETH-only for Gnosis. The Gnosis omnibridge delivers the LEGACY 'USD//C on xDai' token (0xDDAfbb50) for USDC, NOT the USDC.e (0x2a22f9c3) the escrow registers, so a USD transfer via this adapter would strand on arrival. Route USD<->Gnosis via Stargate (delivers USDC.e). WETH (0x6A02…) is unambiguous. No on-chain per-asset guard exists here; this is enforced operationally + by the deploy-time route validator + docs.

CCIP.$comment: Disabled on Gnosis: CCIP has no token pool for the registered assets (USDC/WETH) on this chain, so the router reverts UnsupportedToken. Bridge Gnosis via Stargate for USD (delivers USDC.e) and the native omnibridge for WETH.
